title: Laboratory supplier positioning
goal: A procurement team can compare suppliers on price and assay quality.

rubric.must: Named suppliers are visibly positioned against price and assay-quality axes.
At least one value supplier and one premium-quality supplier are visually distinct.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the matrix/quadrant exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows all four named suppliers positioned on price and assay-quality axes, with category colors and visibly different bubble sizes. Labels are readable, and the quadrant dividers are visible. No material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: Northstar Labs, Meridian Diagnostics, Apex Bioanalytics, and RapidTest Co. are plotted against Low price → Premium price and Basic assay quality → High assay quality axes.
Value suppliers Northstar Labs and RapidTest Co. are blue; premium supplier Meridian Diagnostics is distinctly green and positioned high on assay quality.
The four bubbles have visibly different sizes, with Meridian Diagnostics largest and RapidTest Co. smallest.
All supplier names are legible and placed beside their bubbles.
Vertical and horizontal quadrant divider lines are clearly visible.
